text:
AlexM: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we promised an action list for the instrumentation and ETL gaps that caused missing spans and bad aggregation. TL;DR: need owners, timelines, and validation checks.
MartaG: Root-cause recap: sampler drop during the burst (ingest svc), aggregation window misalignment in the rollup job, and a retry storm that pushed ETL past SLA windows. Logs + postmortem doc linked in thread.
SamT: I can take ownership of the instrumentation fix (sampler parity). Plan: add defensive counters, a metric for sampled-vs-received, and a canary deploy. ETA: 1 week for PR + 2d for canary.
JinR: I'll own the rollup-window bug in the aggregators. Repro locally, add tests for boundary windows, and ship a fix. ETA: 4 days.
PriyaK: I'll handle the ETL backpressure/retry policy — add exponential backoff cap and queue-depth alerts. Also coordinate with infra for a temporary capacity bump during rollout. ETA: 5 days.
observability-bot: Created ticket INC-4589 (instrumentation-sampler-fix) and INC-4590 (aggregator-window-fix) and INC-4591 (etl-retry-policy). Assigned SamT, JinR, PriyaK respectively.
AlexM: Thanks. Can each owner paste the PR link here when opened and a short test plan for analytics to validate? Also add owners to the postmortem remediation table.
SamT: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/8721 (WIP). Test plan: 1) synthetic burst with controlled sampling, 2) check sampled-vs-received metric staying within 0.5% drift, 3) health dashboard not regressing.
JinR: PR draft: https://git.redwood/aggregator/PR/4312. Tests: window edge cases, late-arrival handling, and an integration job that compares old vs new rollups.
PriyaK: PR pending review: https://git.redwood/etl/PR/2209. Plan: replay historical backlog on staging, ensure job completes within SLA, and validate no duplicate aggregation.
analytics-team: For acceptance criteria, we'll need: 1) no missing-span alerts for one full day during canary, 2) aggregation drifts <0.2% on key metrics, 3) ETL job 95th latency below threshold. We'll provide a validation query and baseline.
AlexM: Good. Also add an automated monthly audit that checks for tiny ongoing span-loss patterns — recurring incidents look like "small loss over long time" not single big drops. Can someone add a detection rule?
MartaG: I can add a recurrence detector to the observability ruleset: monthly rolling window, alert if sum(lost_spans) > X and not explained by deploys. ETA: 3 days.
SamT: Will coordinate the canary: low-traffic region first, 6-hour smoke, then global. Rollback if sampled-vs-received > 1%.
JinR: I'll include a migration plan for historical re-aggregation if needed, but we'll avoid heavy retro reprocess unless analytics sign-off.
PriyaK: I'll schedule infra capacity for the ETL replay window and also add a short runbook for on-call to ramp capacity.
AlexM: Assigning near-term checkpoints: 48h status update in this thread, owners update PR status, and confirm observability changes deployed. If all green, we'll mark remediation complete and close postmortem action items.
SamT: 48h update: sampler PR tests passing, canary scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
JinR: 48h update: aggregator fix tests added, CI flaky on one case, debugging.
PriyaK: 48h update: ETL retry PR ready for review, infra slot booked for replay on Friday.
analytics-team: Will run validation after each canary step and post results here. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
AlexM: Closing note — add the remediation owners + ETA into the postmortem doc and set a calendar reminder for a 2-week post-deploy check to look for latent regressions.
MartaG: Done — updated the postmortem table and added the 2-week check.
observability-bot: Reminder: INC-4590 scheduled for canary-audit on 1965510000.
